description: Returns a detailed incident card: status, start/end time, root cause, keyword, replay link, plus screenshot and per-location network diagnostics (headers, body, OpenSSL, ping/nmap/mtr/traceroute, timings). `screenshot` is only returned when `screenshots_enabled` is on the plan; `details` — only when `network_diagnostics_enabled`.
name: incident_get
title: Get incident
